name: Japchae (Korean Sweet Potato Glass Noodles)
whyItWorks: Dangmyeon noodles are made from purified sweet potato starch - 0g insoluble fiber, gluten-free, and super slippery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order or make with thinly sliced beef and soy-sesame-sugar sauce, and pick around any tough onion, mushroom, or bell pepper skins.
